title: Cycle
subtitle: An overview of your current cycle.

phaseDesc.period: Menstruation days — your body is renewing itself. Focus on rest and good nutrition.
phaseDesc.follicular: After your period, energy usually rises as your body prepares for ovulation.
phaseDesc.fertile: Your fertile window — the days when the chance of conception is higher.
phaseDesc.ovulation: Your estimated ovulation day — the peak of the fertile window.
phaseDesc.luteal: From ovulation to your next period — you may notice pre-menstrual signs.

smartTip.title: Smart tip
smartTip.body: Knowing your cycle phases helps you understand your body's needs and align your day with its rhythm.
smartTip.quote: Every cycle is a fresh chance to listen to your body.

empty.title: No cycle logged yet
empty.body: Log your period details to see your cycle overview.
